# This file's own commit is bookkeeping on top of that rev, so it is one commit
# ahead of what it records; the authoritative marker is the server's
# ~/suas-data/.deploy-commit.
#
# Verified:
#  - no hybrid: the server and origin/main resolve to the same rev
#  - live site / returns 200, with the gallery, the hero slides and the calendar
#    intact, and every gallery thumbnail the page names answering 200
#  - the titlebar carries the Admin link, on / and on /about.php
#  - the home page no longer has the "sent in thus far" rail: submissions are
#    not published, and the page is the curated gallery and nothing else
#  - submissions are private at the URL level too: photos/queue/ answers 404,
#    including its thumbnails, so a numbered filename is not a way to see one
#  - a real submission through the public form was accepted into the queue as
#    33.jpg with its credit and caption recorded, was never reachable at its own
#    URL, emailed murray@usydcanoeclub.org (mail.log: outcome "sent", so handed
#    to the local MTA), and was then rejected again, leaving the live queue at
#    the three photos that were already waiting
#  - the Accept path's image step works on this host: photo_load() and
#    photo_write_jpeg() produced a valid 900x600 JPEG at the slide width. That
#    exercise spent number 33, which is what "numbers are never reused" means
#  - admin.php returns 200 with X-Robots-Tag: noindex, and its pending-thumbnail
#    route answers 403 signed out for an existing name and for a missing one
#    alike, so it cannot be used to find out which photos exist
#  - nothing private is served: /includes/*, /suas-config.php, /photos.json and
#    /photos/queue* answer 404; README.md, deploy.sh and server-state.txt are 403
#  - security headers present: HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options,
#    Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
#
# Known, and not a fault of the deploy:
#  - mail.log records the notification as "sent", which means the host's MTA took
#    it. Whether it lands in the inbox rather than a spam folder is not something
#    this file can attest to; SPF and DMARC exist for usydastro.org.
#  - the From address is photos@usydastro.org, which is not a mailbox or a
#    forwarder on this account. It is on the sending domain, which is what SPF
#    needs, and replies go to the submitter via Reply-To, so nothing bounces
#    back to a person. Set notify_from in ~/suas-config.php if that should change.
